This comes from the latest recorded statement, #33: "Enforce HTTPS everywhere, no plaintext exception even for internal services". It replaced the earlier allowance for plain HTTP on internal hosts (#32), and the file doesn't mention that allowance.

Both records are trust-1 episodes, and the catalog lists no decision entry on this topic. I treated #33 as current because it is the later of the two and says it replaces the earlier allowance.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
